name: Ya tebya lyublyu i nenavizhu!
source:
[s]This taste...
I just can't seem to remember its name.[/s]

The story tells you what would happen if the characters of [url=/v3126]Everlasting Summer[/url] realized where they are, as well as how they feel about this world. You will be greeted by all the girls of camp, but don't expect any hospitality from them.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873985045]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[s]这个味道……
我就是记不起它的名字了。[/s]

这个故事告诉你，如果[url=/v3126]夏日永恒[/url]的角色意识到他们在哪里，会发生什么，以及他们对这个世界的感受。营地里所有的女孩都会迎接你，但不要指望她们会热情好客。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873985045]Steam[/url]]
